headline: Meta is making a standalone Muse AI gadget
summary: Meta is developing a dedicated hardware device for its Muse AI agent. The product, named Muse Charm, was briefly unveiled by Mark Zuckerberg. It resembles a chunky smartwatch without a strap, featuring a large screen and lanyard.

headline: Meta Connect 2026: The 7 biggest announcements
summary: Meta showcased new wearables at its Connect event, including VR Glasses. These lightweight VR glasses use a tethered puck for virtual reality. Meta also revealed new screen-free smart glasses and AI advancements.

headline: Meta’s next VR device isn’t a headset — it’s glasses
summary: Meta is launching new VR Glasses, designed to sit like regular glasses. They feature immersive displays for movies, games, and work. These resemble hefty black sunglasses.

headline: Muse is coming to Meta smart glasses
summary: Meta announced its Muse AI agent will be integrated into smart glasses. Users can activate Muse by voice to handle tasks like guiding workouts or logging activities. This includes the new glasses unveiled at Meta Connect.

headline: LEGO’s SMART Play: Millennium Falcon Set Is Down to Its Lowest Price Yet at Amazon With $20 Discount
summary: LEGO's Star Wars SMART Play: Millennium Falcon set is now $79.95 on Amazon. This marks its lowest price ever, saving buyers over $20. Stock up on this popular building kit before prices rise again.

headline: AU Deals: Save $110 on this Super Fast 320Hz Gigabyte Monitor, Score a Free Copy of Street Fighter 6
summary: Gamers can save $110 on a high-speed 320Hz Gigabyte monitor. This deal includes a free copy of the popular game Street Fighter 6. Enhance your gaming setup with this premium display.

headline: Meta’s New VR Glasses to Entice Casual Viewers With 3D and Full-Frame IMAX
summary: Meta's new VR Glasses aim to attract casual users with immersive features. The device offers full 3D viewing capabilities. It also supports full-frame IMAX content for an enhanced entertainment experience.

headline: Warner Bros. Pushes Back DC's Dynamic Duo Film, Gremlins 3 Gets One Year Delay
summary: Warner Bros. has postponed the release of DC's Dynamic Duo film. The highly anticipated Gremlins 3 has also been delayed. Both movies are now pushed back by a full year.

headline: Anti-migrant activist arrested over video of dinghy slashing
summary: An anti-migrant activist, also known as Danny Tommo, has been arrested. Police were investigating footage appearing to show him slashing a dinghy. The incident occurred in the English Channel.

headline: Watch: Trump greets China's Xi beside plane in rare presidential welcome for foreign leader
summary: Donald Trump provided a rare presidential welcome for China's Xi Jinping. They met beside a plane, a significant diplomatic gesture. Two B-1 bombers also flew overhead, showcasing US combat arsenal.

headline: Blood tests find high level of cancer-causing forever chemical in residents near factory
summary: Blood tests revealed high levels of a cancer-causing 'forever chemical'. Residents near a Lancashire chemical factory are affected. They face potential risks of serious health conditions.

headline: What we know after video shows moment of RAF training jet crash
summary: Video footage captured the moment an RAF training jet crashed. Training on Hawk jets has been temporarily halted. An investigation into the incident is currently underway.
